service: baan-thai-backend

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: node22.x
  region: eu-north-1

  iam:
    role: arn:aws:iam::405474549497:role/FullDynamo-FullEvent

  environment:
    TABLE_NAME: RestaurantTable
    JWT_SECRET: ${env:JWT_SECRET, 'dev-secret-change-in-prod'}

  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        - "*"
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
      allowedMethods:
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE

functions:
  #  -------------------USER---------------------
  handleRegister: # register as user or admin
    handler: functions/handleRegister.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/register
          method: POST

  handleLogin: # logs in user or admin
    handler: functions/handleLogin.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/login
          method: POST

  getUserProfile: # gets the userId's profile
    handler: functions/getUserProfile.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/profile/{userId}
          method: GET

  #  -------------------MENU---------------------
  getMenu: # get all meals from the menu
    handler: functions/getMenu.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu
          method: GET

  getProduct: # gets a single menu item
    handler: functions/getProduct.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu/{prodId}
          method: GET

  createMenuItem: # add a new meal to menu
    handler: functions/createMenuItem.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu
          method: POST

  updateMenuItem: # change a meal in menu
    handler: functions/updateMenuItem.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu/{prodId}
          method: PUT

  deleteMenuItem: # removes menu product (menu item === a meal)
    handler: functions/deleteMenuItem.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/menu/{prodId}
          method: DELETE

  #  ---------- INGREDIENTS ----------
  getAllIngredients: # check all ingredients and how much we have of them (ingredient - amount)
    handler: functions/getAllIngredients.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/ingredients
          method: GET

  getIngredient: # check amount of a specific ingredient
    handler: functions/getIngredient.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/ingredients/{ingredientName}
          method: GET

  createIngredient: # add new ingredient
    handler: functions/createIngredient.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/ingredients
          method: POST

  updateIngredient: # change ingredient
    handler: functions/updateIngredient.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/ingredients/{ingredientName}
          method: PUT

  deleteIngredient: # remove ingredient
    handler: functions/deleteIngredient.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/ingredients/{ingredientName}
          method: DELETE

  #  -------------------ORDERS---------------------
  createOrder: # creates an order
    handler: functions/createOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders
          method: POST

  getAllOrders: # gets all orders
    handler: functions/getAllOrders.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders
          method: GET

  getOrderbyUserId: # gets all orders by userId
    handler: functions/getOrdersByUserId.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{userId}
          method: GET

  getOrdersByStatus: # gets all orders by status (pending, locked, completed)
    handler: functions/getOrdersByStatus.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/status/{status}
          method: GET

  updateOrderStatus: # change order status (pending, locked, complete)
    handler: functions/updateOrderStatus.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/status
          method: PUT

  cancelOrder: # userId cancels order
    handler: functions/cancelOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/cancel
          method: PUT

  lockOrder: # admin locks order (no more edits by user can be done)
    handler: functions/lockOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/lock
          method: PUT

  deleteOrder: # removes an order
    handler: functions/deleteOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}
          method: DELETE

  editOrder: # changes an order in case user did something wrong/forgot to add something
    handler: functions/editOrder.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}
          method: PUT

  #  -------------------MESSAGES---------------------
  addOrderMessage: # add message to order (customer or staff)
    handler: functions/addOrderMessage.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/messages
          method: POST

  getOrderMessages: # get all messages for an order
    handler: functions/getOrderMessages.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/messages
          method: GET

  #  -------------------PAYMENTS---------------------
  createPayment: # create payment for order
    handler: functions/createPayment.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/payment
          method: POST

  getPayment: # get payment status
    handler: functions/getPayment.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/orders/{orderId}/payment
          method: GET

  updatePaymentStatus: # update payment status (webhook from provider)
    handler: functions/updatePaymentStatus.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/payments/{paymentId}/status
          method: PUT

  #  -------------------CART---------------------
  getCart: # gets the userId's cart
    handler: functions/getCart.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/cart/{userId}
          method: GET

  updateCart: # updates the userId's cart
    handler: functions/updateCart.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/cart/{userId}
          method: PUT

  clearCart: # empties the userId's cart
    handler: functions/clearCart.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/cart/{userId}
          method: DELETE
